Book Presentation by Ruben Verborgh

On Tuesday 26 January, Ruben Verborgh brings The Insight Economy to Ghent, and this will be no ordinary book launch. In the iconic setting of Wintercircus, the stories from the book come to life on stage: the ideas that make the book so compelling, now in the flesh. Guest speakers join for a debate in which nothing is taken for granted: who owns data, how can we all benefit from it, and can AI truly be done differently? Expect a varied evening full of insight, sharp discussions and moments that will stay with you long after. Afterwards, we keep the conversation going over drinks and you can get your copy of the book signed.

In a room full of senior executives, Ruben Verborgh did something nobody expected: he voluntarily offered them one of his most valuable data points. No one wanted it, and in The Insight Economy he explains why. Companies have been collecting data for decades, yet they extract surprisingly little value from it, and AI is repeating the same mistake. That’s why he returns to the fundamentals of trade: supply, demand, and mutual self-interest. Data shouldn’t move to the AI; the AI should move to the data. The book is written for business leaders, policymakers, and anyone who suspects there’s a better way to approach data and AI.
